newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks end higher, propelled by tech shares.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks end higher, propelled by tech shares.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks ended firmer on Monday, boosted by broad-based strength in high technology stocks, traders said.
"Everything but the semiconductor stocks were up," one trader said. "Internet stocks and other tech stocks were up -- there was strength across the board."
The Nasdaq composite finished up about nine points at 1344 with gainers beating losers by about 2335 to 1897.
Stocks in other sectors of the market were lackluster.
"It all looked firm but I didn't have any enthusiasm today for anything outside of the technology sector," he said.
Citrix Systems Inc shares surged after Microsoft Corp agreed to license its software technology and include it in upcoming versions of Microsoft Windows NT.
Its shares closed up 13-3/8 at 32-5/8, leading the list of most active Nasdaq shares, while Microsoft shares finished up 1-3/8 at 118-1/8.
Among other technology shares, Cisco Systems Inc closed up 1-5/16 at 62-15/16, Netscape Communications Corp traded up 3-5/8 at 35-3/4 and Gateway 2000 was up 1-1/4 at 63-3/4.
